conflicts.description: Calculated nanohardness increment (ΔHc) deviates from experimental nanoindentation increment (ΔHe) for Inconel 617 and Hastelloy N, while consistent for Alloy 800H.

evidence.quote: the calculated hardness ΔHc is basically consistent with the experimental hardness ΔHe in Alloy 800H. In the case of Inconel 617 alloy, ΔHc is smaller than ΔHe, which is caused by the precipitated clusters.
